settings.openLink: Open this link in a browser on a device in your home network:
settings.serverStopped: The web page is not running.
settings.portInUse: Port __port__ is already used by something else.
settings.accessCodeHelp: Without a code, anyone on your network can view the dashboard. With a code, a browser asks for it once and remembers it. For a tablet on the wall you can also open the address with ?code=… added.
settings.editPinHelp: On the dashboard you change the layout with the pencil at the top right. With a PIN, not everyone on your Wi-Fi can do that.
settings.layoutHelp: Choose which blocks you see, in which order and how wide. You can also do this on the dashboard itself, by dragging. On a phone all blocks are stacked.
settings.layoutCustom: You are using your own layout.
settings.layoutDefault: Default layout: blocks appear by themselves as soon as there is a matching device, such as a home battery or EV charger.
settings.ownHeightHelp: The height was set on the dashboard. Tap to let the content decide it again.
settings.devicesHelp: Leave on "Automatic" to have them found for you.
settings.heating: Heating (heat pump or central heating boiler)
settings.noHeating: No heat pump or central heating boiler found
settings.noBattery: No home battery found yet. Once you add your battery to Homey, it appears here by itself.
settings.invertPower: Battery measures power the other way round
settings.invertPowerHelp: Turn on when charging and discharging are swapped on the dashboard
settings.pricesOnHelp: From EnergyZero, for the Netherlands. With a dynamic contract including tax and markup.
settings.showerTooCold: The shower temperature must be higher than that of the cold water.
settings.accessCodeLength: Use at least 4 characters for the access code.
settings.contractHelp: All amounts include VAT. Leave a field empty to leave that cost out.
settings.exportRateHelp: With net metering (salderen, until 2027) this is usually the same as the normal rate.
settings.nettingHelp: Export is then credited at the full price of that hour. Ends on 1 January 2027.
settings.supplierHelp: Price per hour = market price + energy tax + markup. The energy tax of 2026 is filled in.
settings.monthlyHelp: Supply and network costs together, as on your bill. The reduction is deducted spread over the year.
settings.forecastHelp: From Forecast.Solar (free), for the location of your Homey. Shown as a dashed line in "Power today".
settings.checkPrices: Check all amounts against your own contract or your supplier's app. The suggested values are only a starting point: suppliers change their markups, and the dashboard only calculates correctly with your own amounts.
settings.supplierConfirmed: __name__ publishes these amounts on its own website (checked in September 2026). They can have changed since: check them on your contract.
settings.supplierPartly: __name__ publishes the electricity markup on its own website (checked in September 2026); the gas markup comes from a comparison site. Check both on your contract.
settings.supplierUnconfirmed: __name__ does not publish its markup openly; these amounts come from a comparison site (September 2026). Look them up on your contract or in the __name__ app and change them.
settings.supplierNoGas: The gas markup is not known: fill it in yourself.
settings.supplierOther: Fill in your supplier's markup yourself; you find it on your contract or in its app.

widget.name: Energy flows
widget.noP1: No P1 meter found. Choose one in the app settings.
